episode.program:
(rule!
 ;; Recover disconnected jigsaw pieces.  One multicolor piece embeds a distinct
 ;; 2x2 or 3x3 palette; a zero palette entry still occupies physical piece area.
 ;; Keep that piece unrotated at the square's top-left, rotate every other piece
 ;; by quarter turns, exactly tile the square, then recolor each placed piece by
 ;; its palette position.  Reflections are not allowed.
 (lambda (g)
  (let ()
   (define (lex-cell<? a b)
    (or (< (first a) (first b))
        (and (= (first a) (first b)) (< (second a) (second b)))))
   (define (norm cells) (sort (normalize-cells cells) lex-cell<?))
   (define (shift cells dr dc)
    (map (lambda (p) (list (+ dr (first p)) (+ dc (second p)))) cells))
   (define (overlap? a b) (ormap (lambda (p) (member p b)) a))
   (define (rotations shape)
    (let loop ((left 4) (current shape) (seen '()) (out '()))
     (if (= left 0) (reverse out)
      (let ((candidate (norm current)))
       (loop (- left 1) (rotate-cells-cw current)
        (if (member candidate seen) seen (cons candidate seen))
        (if (member candidate seen) out (cons candidate out)))))))
   (define objs (objects-multicolor g 0))
   (define piece-count (length objs))
   (define n (cond ((= piece-count 4) 2) ((= piece-count 9) 3)
                   (else (error 'f560132c "expected four or nine pieces"))))
   (define (color-variety obj)
    (length (remove-duplicates
      (map (lambda (p) (at g (first p) (second p))) (obj-cells obj)))))
   (define key-obj
    (foldl (lambda (obj best)
      (if (> (color-variety obj) (color-variety best)) obj best))
     (first objs) (rest objs)))
   (define key-cells (obj-cells key-obj))
   (define (frequency value)
    (length (filter (lambda (p) (= (at g (first p) (second p)) value)) key-cells)))
   (define palette-candidates
    (for*/list ((r0 (in-range 0 (+ 1 (- (rows g) n))))
                (c0 (in-range 0 (+ 1 (- (cols g) n))))
      #:when
      (let* ((coords (for*/list ((r (in-range n)) (c (in-range n)))
                       (list (+ r0 r) (+ c0 c))))
             (vals (map (lambda (p) (at g (first p) (second p))) coords)))
       (and (= (length (remove-duplicates vals)) (* n n))
            (>= (length (filter (lambda (v) (not (= v 0))) vals)) (- (* n n) 1))
            (andmap (lambda (p)
              (or (= (at g (first p) (second p)) 0) (member p key-cells))) coords))))
     (let* ((coords (for*/list ((r (in-range n)) (c (in-range n)))
                      (list (+ r0 r) (+ c0 c))))
            (vals (map (lambda (p) (at g (first p) (second p))) coords))
            (score (length (filter (lambda (v) (and (not (= v 0)) (> (frequency v) 1))) vals))))
      (list score r0 c0 vals coords))))
   (define (candidate<? a b)
    (or (< (first a) (first b))
        (and (= (first a) (first b))
         (or (< (second a) (second b))
             (and (= (second a) (second b)) (< (third a) (third b)))))))
   (define chosen-palette (first (sort palette-candidates candidate<?)))
   (define palette-values (fourth chosen-palette))
   (define palette-coords (fifth chosen-palette))
   (define key-shape (norm (remove-duplicates (append key-cells palette-coords))))
   (define other-objs (filter (lambda (o) (not (equal? o key-obj))) objs))
   (define pieces (cons key-shape (map (lambda (o) (norm (obj-cells o))) other-objs)))
   (define total-area (apply + (map length pieces)))
   (define side
    (for/first ((s (in-range 1 31)) #:when (= (* s s) total-area)) s))
   (unless side (error 'f560132c "piece areas do not form a square"))
   (define key-placement (list 0 0 0 0 key-shape))
   (define all-placements
    (apply append
     (for/list ((shape (in-list (rest pieces))) (piece-id (in-naturals 1)))
      (apply append
       (for/list ((oriented (in-list (rotations shape))) (rotation (in-naturals 0)))
        (let ((ph (+ 1 (apply max (map first oriented))))
              (pw (+ 1 (apply max (map second oriented)))))
         (for*/list ((dr (in-range 0 (+ 1 (- side ph))))
                     (dc (in-range 0 (+ 1 (- side pw))))
           #:when (let ((cells (shift oriented dr dc)))
                    (not (overlap? cells key-shape))))
          (list piece-id rotation dr dc (shift oriented dr dc)))))))))
   (define full-cells (for*/list ((r (in-range side)) (c (in-range side))) (list r c)))
   (define (search occupied remaining selected)
    (if (empty? remaining) (reverse selected)
     (let* ((target (first (filter (lambda (p) (not (member p occupied))) full-cells)))
            (options (filter (lambda (placement)
              (and (member (first placement) remaining)
                   (member target (fifth placement))
                   (not (overlap? (fifth placement) occupied)))) all-placements)))
      (let try ((choices options))
       (if (empty? choices) #f
        (let* ((placement (first choices))
               (piece-id (first placement))
               (result (search (append (fifth placement) occupied)
                               (remove piece-id remaining)
                               (cons placement selected))))
         (if result result (try (rest choices)))))))))
   (define packed-rest (search key-shape (range 1 piece-count) '()))
   (unless packed-rest (error 'f560132c "pieces cannot tile square"))
   (define packed (cons key-placement packed-rest))
   (define owner
    (build-grid side side (r c)
     (first (first (filter (lambda (placement) (member (list r c) (fifth placement))) packed)))))
   (define positions
    (if (= n 2)
     (list (list (at owner 0 0) (at owner 0 (- side 1)))
           (list (at owner (- side 1) 0) (at owner (- side 1) (- side 1))))
     (let* ((tl (at owner 0 0)) (tr (at owner 0 (- side 1)))
            (bl (at owner (- side 1) 0)) (br (at owner (- side 1) (- side 1)))
            (corners (list tl tr bl br))
            (side-piece (lambda (values)
              (first (remove-duplicates (filter (lambda (v) (not (member v corners))) values)))))
            (tm (side-piece (first owner)))
            (bm (side-piece (last owner)))
            (lm (side-piece (map first owner)))
            (rm (side-piece (map last owner)))
            (used (list tl tm tr lm rm bl bm br))
            (center (first (filter (lambda (id) (not (member id used))) (range piece-count)))))
      (list (list tl tm tr) (list lm center rm) (list bl bm br)))))
   (define piece-colors
    (for*/list ((r (in-range n)) (c (in-range n)))
     (list (at positions r c) (list-ref palette-values (+ (* r n) c)))))
   (build-grid side side (r c)
    (second (assoc (at owner r c) piece-colors))))))
